summary.text: Cindy O'Laughlin is a Republican member of the Missouri Senate for District 18 in northeast Missouri, first elected in 2018, and serves as President Pro Tem.

Her official Senate page says she was elected Majority Floor Leader in 2022, the first woman to hold that position in state history, and lists her as chair of the Administration and Gubernatorial Appointments committees.

paragraphs.text: Her Senate biography says O'Laughlin is the former co-owner of Leo O'Laughlin, Inc., a trucking and ready-mix concrete business, and earlier served as a school bus driver, a school administrator, and a school board member.
It says she previously chaired the Senate Education Committee, is a 1978 graduate of the University of Missouri, and lives in Shelbina.
